candidates.source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — incl. Thesari
candidates.why_relevant: The single most important buyer in this cell: the Treasury (Thesari) owns the government's banking relationships, the KFMIS/public finance management system and the payment/collection rails. Its own site carries procurement notices, budget circulars and Treasury notices that reveal upcoming payment-system procurements before they hit the central portal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the ministry's announcements/procurement sections and its document library; keyword filter on 'thesari', 'sistemi i pagesave', 'shërbime bankare', 'KFMIS'.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of https://kk.rks-gov.net/prishtine/prokurimi/njoftim-per-kontrate/ failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND kk.rks-gov.net from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: DNS did not resolve. This is a HYPOTHESIS of an egress/geo/DNS restriction on this host, NOT evidence the site is dead — the domain appears as a live indexed result under at least two different municipality slugs (prishtine, skenderaj). Must be re-attempted by the deterministic verification pass, ideally from a European egress.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: kk.rks-gov.net is the backbone of this entire cell (~38 municipalities). If it stays unreachable from the collection host, municipal-level banking tenders — the single densest and lowest-visibility segment — are lost.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language search for Kosovo municipal banking-services tenders (opština / javne nabavke / bankarske usluge / platni promet / obaveštenje o ugovoru) returned almost entirely Serbia, Montenegro and Bosnia sources, not Kosovo authorities.
negative_findings.result_summary: The only Kosovo-specific sr-language hit was the official Serbian translation of the public procurement instruction on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net. No Serbian-language procurement page of a Kosovo municipality (e.g. the four northern municipalities) was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kosovo law provides for Serbian as an official language and Serb-majority municipalities are genuine contracting authorities with their own banking arrangements. Failing to reach them leaves a language-and-territory hole, and sr-language queries also risk polluting the corpus with Serbia-proper tenders that must be filtered out.

negative_findings.description: No authority-hosted notice explicitly for bank current-account / salary-payment / e-payment-gateway services was retrieved during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language terms were used ('shërbime bankare', 'llogari rrjedhëse', 'pagesa elektronike', 'arkëtim', 'bankarske usluge', 'platni promet') but search surfaced the procurement PAGES rather than any matching individual notice. The observed authority-hosted notices were for other categories (insurance, lab equipment, uniforms, books, oils).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's core thesis needs document-level crawling, not search-engine discovery: these notices exist as PDFs inside listing pages that search engines index poorly. Budget for full-text PDF harvesting rather than query-based discovery.

negative_findings.description: No own-site procurement page located for several important buyers: KEK (kek-energy.com), Trepça Sh.A., regional water utilities (Ujësjellësi Rajonal), and SHSKUK / individual hospitals.
negative_findings.result_summary: These authorities were confirmed to exist and to procure, but only via the central portal, media reporting, or aggregators. Their own procurement URLs were not identified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POEs and hospitals are large-payroll, high-cash-handling buyers. If they publish only centrally, the cell's added value for them is zero and coverage should be delegated to the central-portal cell instead of duplicated here.

coverage_gaps.description: No authoritative list of Kosovo contracting authorities with their web domains was assembled — municipality slugs for kk.rks-gov.net, which authorities use own subdomains (gjakova.rks-gov.net style), and which have no site at all are all unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain the official register of contracting authorities (KRPP/AQP publish one) and join it against a domain-discovery pass; that register converts this cell from ad-hoc search into systematic enumeration.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language Kosovo municipal sources (North Mitrovica, Zvečan, Zubin Potok, Leposavić and other Serb-majority municipalities) are entirely uncovered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run sr queries with municipality names spelled in Serbian plus a site: restriction to rks-gov.net, and check whether kk.rks-gov.net serves an /sr/ or ?lang=sr variant per municipality.

coverage_gaps.description: Every candidate in this slice is marked access-unverified; only one live fetch was attempted and it failed on DNS. Liveness, robots.txt posture and bot-defence behaviour are unknown across the whole cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass from an EU egress, capture robots.txt and HTTP status per domain, and re-classify anything returning 403 as bot-defended-but-live rather than dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Bid-opening minutes, tender dossiers and signed contract PDFs — the detail this cell exists to capture, over and above the central portal — were only confirmed at msh.rks-gov.net and bqk-kos.org. Whether municipalities publish that depth is untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once kk.rks-gov.net is reachable, sample 5 municipalities and inventory which document types each publishes; use that to score whether municipal crawling is worth the ongoing cost.

coverage_gaps.description: Health-sector buyers below the ministry (SHSKUK, regional hospitals, QKUK) and the pension/social-transfer payment side of MFPT were not reached, despite being among the largest disbursement operations in the country.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted pass on SHSKUK and on MFPT's social-transfer/pension payment units, searching sq terms 'pagesa e pensioneve', 'transferet sociale', 'shërbime bankare për pagesa'.

brief: Kosovo contracting authorities do publish procurement on their own sites, but in three different shapes: a shared municipal CMS (kk.rks-gov.net/<komuna>/, with at least two competing path variants), standalone institutional subdomains (gjakova.rks-gov.net, dogana.rks-gov.net, msh.rks-gov.net, bqk-kos.org), and a few POEs that appear to publish only through the central portal. The richest own-site layers found are MSH's year-indexed contract-document library and BQK's tender PDFs, which confirm the cell's premise that authority sites carry B05/B08 documents at a depth search engines do not index. The binding constraints are access and enumeration, not source scarcity: the municipal backbone did not resolve from this environment (a restriction hypothesis, not a dead host), no register of authorities-to-domains was obtained, and Serbian-language Kosovo municipal sources remain wholly uncovered. No notice specifically for bank account, salary-payment or e-payment-gateway services was surfaced by search, which argues for document-level PDF harvesting over query-based discovery in the collection design.
